title: Autothreshold
text: Convert intensity image to binary image, 1 input, 3 outputs, {When data range is exceeded} sets Operation to perform when data range is exceeded; {Thresholding operator}, {Output threshold}, {Output effectiveness metric}, {Specify data range} sets the input pixel value range, {Minimum value of input} sets the minimum input pixel value, {Maximum value of input} sets the maximum input pixel value, {Scale threshold}, {Threshold scaling factor} scales factor for thresholding and {Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools} sets the data type override. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Specify data range
params.values: Specify input pixel value range off (default) | on

params.name: When data range is exceeded
params.values: Operation to perform when data range is exceeded Ignore (default) | Saturate | Warn and saturate | Error

params.name: Lock data type settings against change by the fixed-point tools
